نلتقط (form VIII)
# نَلْتَقِطُ (naltaqiṭu) /nal.ta.qi.tˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِلْتَقَطَ (iltaqaṭa)
# نُلْتَقَطُ (nultaqaṭu) /nul.ta.qa.tˤu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَقَطَ (iltaqaṭa)
# نَلْتَقِطَ (naltaqiṭa) /nal.ta.qi.tˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِلْتَقَطَ (iltaqaṭa)
# نُلْتَقَطَ (nultaqaṭa) /nul.ta.qa.tˤ
